title: Improving Urban Accessibility and Quality of Life: A Case Study of a Linear Park Neighborhood
content: This study investigates the role of urban accessibility in creating inclusive and sus-tainable cities by analyzing Kaimakli Linear Park in Nicosia, Cyprus. A mixed-methods approach—comprising literature review, field observation, stakeholder interviews, and policy review—was employed to evaluate the park's compliance with Universal Design (UD) principles. Findings reveal systemic challenges including inadequate infrastruc-ture, fragmented governance, and weak enforcement of accessibility standards. The study proposes actionable design interventions and policy recommendations to en-hance physical and social inclusion in urban green spaces. It contributes to the broader discourse on inclusive urbanism and practical strategies for equitable city development.
